organization.name_ja: アサヒグループホールディングス株式会社

affected.note: Possible-leak figures as of 2025-11-26 (sum of published categories): about 1,525,000 customers who contacted the customer service desks of Asahi Breweries, Asahi Soft Drinks and Asahi Group Foods, 114,000 external contacts for congratulatory and condolence services, 107,000 current and former employees and 168,000 employee family members. As of 2026-02-18, leakage was confirmed for 115,513 people: 5,117 employees (included in the possible-leak figures) and 110,396 people at business partners and sole proprietors. No credit card data was involved.

summary.en: Asahi Group Holdings suffered a ransomware attack that caused a system failure on 2025-09-29. It reported that personal data of about 1.914 million customers, external contacts, employees and their families may have leaked, and later confirmed leakage for 115,513 people.
summary.ja: アサヒグループホールディングスは2025年9月29日、ランサムウェア攻撃によるシステム障害が発生した。顧客、社外関係者、従業員とその家族など約191.4万人分の個人情報が漏えいしたおそれがあると公表し、その後115,513件の漏えいを確認した。
